published_stories.title: Flai’s AI dealership software is booking 50,000 appointments per month
published_stories.summary: Flai's revenue has grown 20x in a year, and the company just closed a $27 million Series A funding round.

published_stories.title: Etched fields funding offers at $40B+ valuation, sources say
published_stories.summary: Just a couple of months after its last big raise, the AI chip startup is already being plied with investment offers at double or more its current value, sources tell TechCrunch.

published_stories.title: After Factory’s public spat with Khosla, Menlo proudly invests
published_stories.summary: Days after Vinod Khosla called Factory a struggling also-ran, Menlo has shown up with a check and a glowing blog post.

published_stories.title: Glimpse wants to give hardware companies an X-ray view of every critical part
published_stories.summary: Called Explore, Glimpse's new image processing software lets hardware makers speed up quality control checks using CT scanners.

published_stories.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
published_stories.summary: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

published_stories.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
published_stories.summary: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

published_stories.title: Mistral Says Its New AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Is the Best Open-Weight Offering Outside of China
published_stories.summary: With the release of its new trillion-parameter model, Mistral is hoping to demonstrate it’s “still in the race” to build frontier-level artificial intelligence.

published_stories.title: Kevin Roose Didn’t Use AI to Write His Book About AI
published_stories.summary: The author of The AGI Chronicles says his book “was written by a very tired, overworked, under-slept human being.”

published_stories.title: Rural Data Centers Are in for a Big Federal Tax Break
published_stories.summary: Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, data center projects in rural areas could be eligible for major tax benefits starting next year. Some hyperscalers do not seem eager to take the free cash.

published_stories.title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
published_stories.summary: Pinterest’s new AI-powered Beauty Guides translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology, with estimated costs, appointment times and maintenance needs.

published_stories.title: Get all your questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: The full breakout session agenda revealed
published_stories.summary: Get all of your scaling and tech questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Here's the full breakout session agenda, happening October 13-15 in San Francisco. Register now to join and save up to $100, and get a second pass at 50% off.

published_stories.title: The Nvidia Shield TV Is 7 Years Old. It Just Got a $100 Price Hike
published_stories.summary: The price of anything with memory is skyrocketing thanks to AI. Aging streaming devices are no exception.

published_stories.title: Emmys will move from broadcast TV to Prime Video in 2027
published_stories.summary: Non-Amazon Prime subscribers will be able to watch the awards show on the platform.

published_stories.title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
published_stories.summary: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

published_stories.summary: Millions have downloaded Meta’s AI agent Muse. But getting it to do your bidding comes with privacy costs.

published_stories.title: Furientis lands $25M from Benchmark to mass-produce low-cost missile interceptors
published_stories.summary: The storied Silicon Valley firm makes its first pure defense investment.

published_stories.title: Learn all about scaling, fundraising, founder how-tos, and more at TechCrunch Founder Summit, November 4
published_stories.summary: There isn’t a single manual to read or prompt to give an LLM that can equip you with the skills and knowledge to build a company. But on November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit gives founders the next-best thing: A packed day at Boston's SoWa Power Station, where investors and operators share how they've navigated crucial decisions.

published_stories.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
published_stories.summary: "We created this program because we believe the benefits of AI will reach most people through the companies that build on top of models, rather than through the models alone."

published_stories.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
published_stories.summary: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

published_stories.title: LibreOffice says ‘no AI’ is now a software feature
published_stories.summary: The maker of the open source document editor says it has no plans to add AI to its software's default configuration, citing user privacy.

published_stories.summary: Wajo's Fo agent can hire humans to complete a task.
